meta.title: Clean the Supermarket Grocery Items

sources.label: Clean the Supermarket Roblox (cleanthesupermarket.com) - Canonical aisle table (shelf-codes)
Clean the Supermarket Roblox (cleanthesupermarket.com) - Item checklist (60 items)

sourceNotes: All 60 item-to-aisle-to-shelf-color rows come from a single unofficial fan source, cleanthesupermarket.com (author jimliu_dev). The site explicitly states it is NOT affiliated with the game developer (Tidyverse), Roblox, or Roblox Corporation. Treat values as best-effort; the source itself warns item and aisle names should be rechecked against the live Roblox build.

Item count of 60 is confirmed two ways: the shelf-codes canonical table lists 10 aisles x 6 example items, and the /collectibles checklist reads '0 of 60 tracked' and lists 60 rows prefixed with aisle codes A1-A10.

Roblox game identity verified via games.roblox.com (universe 10334731049, root place 120450743769548, creator Tidyverse). The Roblox API does not expose the grocery item-to-aisle mapping, so item rows are sourced from the community site, not the API.

Section grouping is by aisle (A1-A10) because the entire game loop is deciding which aisle an item belongs to; grouping items under their destination aisle mirrors the in-game sorting decision. Within each aisle, items keep the source's listed order, not alphabetical.
Shelf color is the in-game visual cue for each aisle (e.g. A3 Dairy & Chilled = blue). 'ice' (A4) and 'dark red' (A9) are the source's exact color labels.
No per-item art exists on the source (text-only checklist). Images are deferred to the image gate and are null here. Images are NOT a data blocker.
Evergreen-safe: no dates, counts, or freshness wording in any rendered prose field; the {count} token handles the title count and the updatedAt/source dates live only in this hidden meta.
